about: What tools/unreal-engine/python/build_ui.py adds to the menu (/Game/Lunden/UI/). Other issues add their own rows here instead of opening the UI Blueprints, then rebuild the UI. menuButtons: a button on the start/pause menu's main page (between Inställningar and Avsluta) that opens `widget` (a UserWidget class path ending in _C) over the open menu with the menu's player as owner; the widget removes itself (RemoveFromParent) when it is done and the menu keeps the mouse and keyboard. name: a unique identifier (the button is Ext<name>); label: the Swedish button text. volumes: one slider on the settings page per row, saved as `key` (0..1, default 1) in the save slot; when soundClass names a SoundClass the volume is applied to it (and its children) through the SoundMix /Game/Lunden/UI/SM_LundenVolumes, at game start and on every change; null keeps the slider and the saved value until the class exists. owner: the issue that owns the row and its asset; what: one line. docs/development/unreal.md#menu-settings-and-compass-2286

menuButtons.name: Look
menuButtons.label: Utseende
menuButtons.what: the look menu: type or paste a look code (a web code works), step through sample looks, apply it to the player's figure (seen in the hall mirror) and save it

volumes.label: Huvudvolym
volumes.what: every sound: #2287's project root class SC_LundenMaster, parent of the effects and music classes (the engine's own Master cannot hold project classes as children)

volumes.label: Musik
volumes.what: music and radios: #2287's SC_LundenMusic (child of SC_LundenMaster); nothing plays in it until the music player is ported

volumes.label: Ljudeffekter
volumes.what: doors, steps, animals and other effects: #2287's SC_LundenEffects (child of SC_LundenMaster) with SC_LundenAmbience (wind, outdoor bed) under it
